result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility issue: the promotional banner has severely insufficient text contrast.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' promotional banner, the white heading and subtext ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout • min. order €10') have very low contrast against the pale mint-green background, making the text difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color (such as dark green or charcoal) on the light background, or darken the banner background so the white text meets WCAG AA contrast requirements.
